scenes.beat: New Game prologue: arriving at Ashcroft for the first shift

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Ashcroft State Forensic Hospital. Today is your first shift as the ward's new psychiatrist.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Every door here is logged. Your badge says who you are, and the system decides where you may go.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A desk, a terminal, and a caseload you have not met yet.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The patients on this ward were sent by the courts. Your job is to see each of them clearly, and to record only what you observe.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The charge nurse is expecting you at the nursing station. Start there.
